target_id.description: Exact id of who here died.

name: leave_party
description: Make a party member stop travelling with the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: direct
description: End the turn and give notes to the narrator. Call this last, once per turn. Include the answer or result, its known reason, and facts needed for the next choice. Share only facts the player can know now. Apply world changes through the other tools before calling direct.

text.description: Brief factual notes for the narrator to phrase. Answer each question in the player action. Include the result, its known reason, and details needed for the next choice. For a request or warning, give what the person wants and the reason they share. Use facts the player can know now. Identify claims and unknown reasons as such. Keep every outcome consistent with tool results.

name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity here known to the player. HIDDEN HERE lists what the player has not found: call this before you tell a hidden thing.

target_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here.

name: move_item
description: Move an item to a new holder.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item here or carried.

holder_id.description: Exact id of the player, an npc here, or this place.

name: unlock_way
description: Open a locked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the locked way's destination.

name: move
description: Move the player through an unlocked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place to move to.

with_ids.description: Exact ids of living npcs here who follow one time. Party members come without this field.

name: meanwhile
description: Pass time in the world. Call this before `direct` on each turn that shows ELSEWHERE. Give at most the number of changes that ELSEWHERE shows. Give an empty list when nothing moves.

changes.description: Each dweller, item and way changes at most once. Party members and their items never change.

kind.description: A dweller walks along one unlocked way, also into or out of the player's place.
An item goes to a place or to a living dweller.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place or the dweller.

kind.description: A way that the player knows locks on both sides. The player always keeps one open way out.

from_id.description: Exact id of one end of the way.

to_id.description: Exact id of the other end of the way.

kind.description: A locked way that the player knows unlocks on both sides.

from_id.description: Exact id of one end of the way.

to_id.description: Exact id of the other end of the way.

kind.description: A dweller away from the player dies.

name: extend_map
description: Extend the map past its edge. Call this when MAP EDGE shows and the player heads past it: after the goal here is met, or when they set out somewhere new. Call it last: it ends your turn.

heading.description: Where the player heads past the map's edge, in their own words.

name: join_party
description: Make a person here travel with the player. Set `terms` when the player hires them to work, also someone who already travels with the player: the worldsmith writes their sheet at the end of the turn, and nothing more happens this turn. Leave `terms` empty for someone who only comes along.

target_id.description: Exact id of who here joins or is hired.

terms.description: Empty when they only come along. When the player hires them to work: what for and on what terms, as agreed.

name: rest
description: Rest the player and the party here for one night. Their Health goes to full.

name: roll
description: Roll for an uncertain action that has a real cost. The engine rolls 2d6, adds the ability and the items, and reads the total.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

ability.description: The ability that the action uses.

item_ids.description: Exact ids of items the actor carries and that clearly help.

difficulty.description: Difficulty Score: 8 easy, 10 moderate, 12 hard. Null when `target_id` is set.

target_id.description: Exact id of an npc here that the actor acts on, in a fight or in talk. The Health of that npc is the Difficulty Score.

dangerous.description: True when a miss would hurt. Talk is not dangerous unless the story says so.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: level_up
description: Level up one time, when the whole adventure ends. The engine gives the choice to the player first, then to each living hired member in turn.

ability.description: The ability to raise by 1. Null asks the player.

boost.description: Health or Inventory: which one to raise by 1. Null asks the player.
